sampling.method: op2 dense video_frames: ffmpeg accurate seek, one full-resolution PNG per requested timestamp, 5 frames from 0 to 4.0s every 1s

pixel_observations.description: Portrait-format (360x640) clip of an ultrasound sector image (apical four-chamber-like view, depth ticks 5/10/15 along the left edge, small yellow 'V' marker at the apex, a thin cyan baseline strip below) shown on a dark rectangle with white margins above and below and a white 'vimeo' watermark at bottom right; the picture looks photographed or screen-recorded. Across the five 1-second samples the ventricular walls and valve echoes change position. No readable measurements, patient name, ID, date or face visible. No audio track.

author_context.subject: patient

evidence.quote: Follow-up transthoracic echocardiogram (apical view) at one month showed normalization of left ventricular systolic function, with an estimated ejection fraction of 50%-52%.
LVEF of 28% on Day 1 recovered to 50% at one-month follow-up

author_context.rationale: Video 2 caption and the follow-up paragraph tie the clip to the case patient's one-month echocardiogram; normalization and EF come from the text, not the pixels.

limitations: Sampled frames only; intervening frames and continuous motion were not viewed.
Original MP4 (4.1 s, 360x640, no audio track) sampled every 1 s from 0 to 4 s (5 frames); frames between samples and continuous motion not viewed.
Normalization of systolic function and EF are not assessed from the frames.
